enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Shift legs. Move arm under pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Fill kettle with water and turn on. Crack eggs into bowl. Turn on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and grooming at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Sit at desk. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Check phone. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the telehealth workstation on the computer and reviewing the day's patient schedule, since the transport strike prevents commuting to the clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open telehealth software. Check camera. Check microphone. Adjust camera angle. Check internet connection. Open patient schedule. Review patient list. Make notes on paper. Check email. Print patient schedule. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Fill glass with water. Walk back to bedroom. Place glass on desk. Sit down. Open patient notes. Read notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting telehealth consultations with patients and updating clinical notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open first patient file. Start video call. Greet patient. Ask about symptoms. Listen to patient. Type notes. Ask follow-up questions. End call. Update clinical notes. Save notes. Open next patient file. Start video call. Repeat. Take short break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue consultations.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a quick lunch in the microwave and eating it during a work break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place leftovers in microwave. Close microwave door. Set timer. Press start. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out container. Close microwave. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Clear dishes. Walk back to bedroom. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing telehealth patient consultations, following up on test results and completing documentation on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open patient files. Review test results. Call patient. Discuss test results. Type notes. Update documentation. Save. Open next patient file. Start video call. Consult patient. Type notes. End call. Update notes. Save. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and freshening up after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Dry body.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for a load of laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Place clothes into washing machine. Close washing machine door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close detergent drawer. Set wash cycle. Press start. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down time reading on the phone with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Scroll through articles. Read article. Tap to next article. Read article. Adjust lamp angle. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Walk back to bedroom. Sit at desk. Continue reading. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.
Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Shift legs. Move arm. Remain still. Sleep.
